# College of Commissioner Science

## Curriculum for All Degree Programs

Click on the links below for the most current version of the nationally
provided College of Commissioner Science courses:

**_Current Curriculum_**

The Curriculum Review Team will be updating courses on a regular basis. The
most current can be found here:

  * [Bachelors](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/training/college-of-commissioner-science/bachelors-courses/)
  * [Masters](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/training/masters-courses/)
  * [Doctorate](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/training/doctorate-courses/)
  * [Continuing Education](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/training/continuing-ed/)

As facilitators and trainers for this curriculum, we are charged with
representing Scouting America and delivering this national material. To stay
consistent across the nation, the content of the training should be delivered
as designed and written. Therefore, the materials on the Scouting America
Commissioner Development CCS webpage are provided in a “Read-Only”
downloadable format to support uniformity of content. This ensures the same
message is delivered as we provide a unified approach to unit service.
Consistent and Repeatable delivery assures fair reciprocity (the transfer of
your class work between colleges of commissioner science in different
councils/host groups) in the work toward a degree or award. This has become
more important with the option of virtual colleges.

  
[How to open and print the CCS PowerPoint files](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2022/02/Opening-Printing-College-of-Commissioner-Science-
PowerPoints.pdf)

For both current and archived.  Each course is in a zip file that is self-
contained with all materials—course outline, teaching notes, PowerPoint
presentation, and handouts necessary to teach the course. Simply click on the
link and download the file.  
  

## Administrative Handbook

The College of Commissioner Science is a significant event and requires
detailed planning to be successful.

The Administrative Handbook provides local councils with resources for
delivering a great College of Commissioner Science.

This new handbook is accessed here: [College of Commissioner Science
Administrative Handbook](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2023/02/College-of-Commissioner-Science-Administrative-
Handbook-1.pdf) and includes information and downloadable resources. The
handbook includes a series of documents with hyperlinks to the documents. This
format provides commissioners the opportunity to create their own hard copy
book, or download it to a device of choice.

The previous Administrative Resources are now obsolete and have been replaced
with this handbook.

## Feedback on Curriculum

Commissioners are encouraged to provide feedback on our College of
Commissioner Science curriculum and Administrative Resources. If you have
suggestions for updates or if you note errors in the material, please use the
form below to share your comments. All feedback is collected by the Curriculum
Review Team and is considered for future updates
